title: fix(plugin-form): an Edit form saves the owner the user changed or cleared, and still never echoes an untouched one
body:
Fixes #12205

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Changing or clearing the owner in a record's Edit form was silently dropped. `sanitizeFormData` (`packages/plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts`) removed `owner_id` from every form payload, so the value never reached the server. When the owner was the only change, the edit's dirty diff (objectui#10156) found nothing else and sent the whole unchanged payload. That is exactly the PATCH the card measured: every other field, and no `owner_id`.

Reproduced on the base commit `9646e2e` through the console's Edit dialog (`ModalForm`) and `DrawerForm`, with the real lookup widget: reassigning the owner sent `{ subject, status }` and no `owner_id`.

## The fix

`dirtyEditPayload` is the one place that can tell a change from an echo, because it holds the record the form read. It now also receives the values the form holds (an optional `EditOwnerSource`). It adds `owner_id` back to the diff when, and only when, all of these hold:

- a loaded-record snapshot applies to this edit. With none (a create, a caller-supplied record, a record swap in flight) the owner stays dropped, exactly as before;
- the form holds a value for it, and `changedFields` reports it as different from the read. A clear arrives as `null`; `undefined` is not a clear;
- everything else `sanitizeFormData` asks still allows it: the caller's field-level security (`canEdit`), the object declaring the field, and the field not being `readonly` or computed.

The strip loop moved into a module-private `stripUnwritable`, which takes an `admitOwner` flag that only `dirtyEditPayload` sets. `sanitizeFormData`'s signature and output are unchanged, and its output still never carries the owner. `SERVER_OWNED_FIELD_NAMES` is unchanged: no second strip list, and no new admit list beyond the single constant naming `owner_id`. The server stays the authority. A role without the transfer grant gets a 403, and the form shows it as its error.

## Dispatch hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (the drop route).** Both routes fire on the HotCRM-shaped edit, where a definition is present. The name roster drops `owner_id` first. The spec `system` flag branch would drop it too, because the platform serves `owner_id` as `OWNER_FIELD_DEF` (`system: true`, `readonly: false`). Both are bypassed, for `owner_id` alone and only on the admission path.
- **H2 (the dirty diff).**
  - `isSameStoredValue(null, 'u1')` is false, so a clear is a change.
  - An untouched owner keeps the shape it was read with. `LookupField` calls `onChange` only on a pick or a remove, so the untouched value compares equal, whether the record holds an id or an expanded object (both are pinned).
  - A new pick over an expanded stored owner reads as a change, which is the side that sends.
  - With no snapshot, or a snapshot read for another record, the owner is not sent (pinned).
- **H3 (which columns).** Only `owner_id`. The spec declares `owning_business_unit_id` and `organization_id` `readonly` (scope anchors stamped by the server), and no form edits a tenancy column. So `owning_business_unit_id`, `organization_id`, `tenant_id`, `company_id` and `space` stay refused even when they differ (pinned). The audit columns are untouched.
- **H4 (the callers).**
  - `ModalForm.tsx` and `DrawerForm.tsx` call `sanitizeFormData` and `dirtyEditPayload` directly. Each now passes `{ values: data, objectSchema, canEdit }`.
  - `formWritePayload` (`writePayload.ts`) passes the same inputs. That covers `ObjectForm`'s simple layout and the tabbed, split and wizard layouts, with no edit to `ObjectForm.tsx` (objectui#12209 holds it).
  - The master-detail batch (`masterDetailTx.ts`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx`) is unchanged. Its child rows and its parent operation still drop the owner by name, so an untouched owner stays off every operation of the batch (pinned through a real `MasterDetailForm` whose header renders the owner).
- **H5 (a refusal surfaces).** It already did. A rejected update goes through the form renderer's submit catch, which shows `form.noPermissionToSave` as a banner and a toast, and the dialog stays open. This is now pinned for an owner change: a 403 shows the message, and neither `onSuccess` nor `onOpenChange(false)` is called.
- **H6 (auto-layout).** `filterSystemFields` still reads the unchanged roster, so an auto-laid-out form renders no owner input. The owner is written only when its value differs from the read, which only a rendered input can cause. Pinned: an auto-laid-out Edit dialog has no `lookup-trigger-owner_id`, and a business-field change sends only that field.

## Tests

New file: `packages/plugin-form/src/editOwnerChange-12205.test.tsx`, 28 rows.

- **Unit rows on `dirtyEditPayload` and `formWritePayload`:** reassign, clear, a change beside other fields, untouched (beside a change and in a save with nothing changed), an untouched expanded owner, no snapshot or another record's snapshot, a create, field-level security refusing it, an object declaring it `readonly`, an `undefined` value, the rest of the family plus the audit columns, a caller passing no owner source, and inline members.
- **Component rows with the real lookup widget:**
  - `ModalForm` (the console's Edit dialog) and `DrawerForm`: reassign, clear, untouched beside a change, untouched with nothing changed;
  - the 403 surfacing;
  - the auto-layout render;
  - `ObjectForm` simple: reassign and untouched;
  - `MasterDetailForm`: untouched owner, header change, no operation carries `owner_id`.

**Reverse verification at `78486a7`.** The four source files were reset to the base `9646e2e` and the new file was run; the mutation was proven on disk by `grep -c` (0 hits for the fix's markers, 1 hit for the base drop line). Result: `Tests 11 failed | 17 passed (28)`. All 11 red rows assert that a changed or cleared owner is sent (one of them then asserts that the 403 surfaces). The 17 that stay green are the "is not sent" rows and the guards, which the base already satisfied. The restore used `git checkout HEAD`, was proven by matching each file's HEAD blob hash, and `git diff HEAD` came back empty.

**Final run at `268c7e9`, through the verify lock:**

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (the script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project lists the new file): exit 0.
- Targeted vitest over 45 files, `Test Files 45 passed (45)`, `Tests 541 passed (541)`:
  - every plugin-form test naming sanitize, writePayload, dirty-edit, owner or master-detail;
  - the objectui#10108 pin `systemManagedPayload.test.tsx`;
  - the three objectui#12103 pins (permissions, plugin-detail, plugin-grid);
  - the Modal and Drawer save-path suites: field security, OCC, record swap, submit seam, upload gate, custom-fields merge.
- Dependency build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-form^...' --concurrency=2`: 11/11 tasks, cached.

## Gates (at `268c7e9`)

- All exit 0:
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`;
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `pnpm check:doc-fences`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:readme-exports`. Its prerequisite is a full workspace build (it stopped with "type entry is not on disk" for unbuilt packages and a collapsed population). CI runs it.
- ESLint, narrowed to the changed files:
  - Population: `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, so the five changed TS/TSX files are the whole population. The markdown files are outside it.
  - Count: the `--format json` output lists 5 files, with 0 errors.
  - Why nothing else can move: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
  - Warnings per file, base to head: `sanitize.ts` 8 to 7, `writePayload.ts` 0 to 0, `ModalForm.tsx` 20 to 20, `DrawerForm.tsx` 21 to 21. The new test file has 21, all `no-explicit-any` in fixtures.
- The governed-surface guard answers NOT GOVERNED for all 8 paths.

## Acceptance notes

- **The master-detail header owner is still not saved.** This is the same defect class, and this PR leaves it as it was. `buildMasterDetailEditBatch` strips the roster from the parent operation by name (`parentWritable`) and holds no parent baseline. So it cannot tell an owner the header changed from an echoed one, and giving it one is not a bounded change. It would need the header `ObjectForm`'s snapshot, and objectui#12209 holds that file.
  - Measured with a throwaway probe at `78486a7`, not committed: when the owner is the header's only change, the parent operation is now `data: {}`. On the base commit it was the full unchanged business payload. Both are no-op writes as far as the owner goes, and the user-visible outcome is the same as before.
  - The changeset and the README both state that a master-detail header owner change is still not saved.
- **File surface widened, for docs only.** `packages/plugin-form/README.md` ("What an edit save writes") and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` both said that every layout strips the ownership columns. This change makes that false, so both now state the edit-only exception (the Docs-driven commandment in AGENTS.md).
- `ObjectForm.tsx` is not touched. Its routes get the fix through `formWritePayload`.
